title: Alisa Clairmont
summary: Alisa Clairmont is a rich and ill-mannered woman who visits Venice, Italy every year from France. She attempted to reserve a room in the Venice Hotel for her and her dog but became angry at Sophie Casterwill when she was politely told that the East penthouse was already occupied.

When LeBlanche voiced his complaints at the dog wounding him, Alisa Clairmont became angry and hit both LeBlanche and Lok with her purse. sections.wikitext:
Alisa Clairmont is extremely ill-mannered and self-important, especially towards people who she believes are less than her, such as hotel staff. She is also bad-tempered and aggressive, as seen in her habit of using her handbag to hit people. In contrast, she doted over her dog and pampered it as if it were a spoilt child. {{source|All Work and No Pay}}

full_text:
Alisa Clairmont is a rich and ill-mannered woman who visits Venice, Italy every year from France. She attempted to reserve a room in the Venice Hotel for her and her dog but became angry at Sophie Casterwill when she was politely told that the East penthouse was already occupied.

History

When trying to reserve a room in the Venice Hotel, Alisa Clairmont's dog bit both Lok Lambert and LeBlanche. When LeBlanche voiced his complaints at the dog wounding him, Alisa Clairmont became angry and hit both LeBlanche and Lok with her purse. Upon trying to similarly strike at Sophie, who tried to no avail to calm Alisa Clairmont down, Santiago used a Shadowpoint spell on her bag. This action resulted in a fight, leading to the Huntik team being fired from the hotel. [All Work and No Pay]

Personality

Alisa Clairmont is extremely ill-mannered and self-important, especially towards people who she believes are less than her, such as hotel staff. She is also bad-tempered and aggressive, as seen in her habit of using her handbag to hit people. In contrast, she doted over her dog and pampered it as if it were a spoilt child. [All Work and No Pay]
